operating_notes.text: HCLTech launched a dedicated Gemini Enterprise Business Unit to accelerate Agentic AI adoption.
Advanced AI revenue for Q4FY26 reached $155.1 million, up 6.1% QoQ.
HCLTech was positioned as a Leader in Everest Group's Application Transformation Services for AI-enablement PEAK Matrix Assessment 2025.
HCLTech announced a multi-year partnership with the DP World Tour as its Official Digital Experience Partner.
HCLTech expanded its partnership with MetLife Stadium, New York Jets and New York Giants as an Official AI Partner.
Collaborated with Red Hat to launch the HCLTech AI Factory built on Red Hat AI Enterprise.
Released Enterprise AI Market Report indicating 43% failure risk in enterprise AI initiatives.
Named Citrix GSI of the Year for enterprise digital workplace transformation and cloud adoption.
Expanded collaboration with Pegasystems to accelerate AI-powered enterprise system modernization using HCLTech AI Force and Pega Blueprint.
Launched Autonomous Finance Platform for use with Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise.
Launched AI Innovation Zone in Santa Clara in collaboration with Google Cloud using Gemini Enterprise.
Advanced AI annualized revenue reached $876 million in Q2FY27.
Launched NVIDIA-powered Verification and Validation (V&V) for Auto to automate software-defined vehicle validation workflows.
Announced partnership with Rapidus Corporation to establish semiconductor engineering development centers in Bengaluru and Hubli.
Launched AI-powered nano GCC offering built on AWS, supported by the Center of Excellence in Lucknow.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹33,981 Cr (+12.3% YoY), net profit ₹4,490 Cr (+4.2% YoY).
HCLTech launched a dedicated Gemini Enterprise Business Unit to accelerate agentic AI adoption and won two 2026 Google Cloud Partner of the Year Awards.
HCLTech reported Q4FY26 revenue of $3,682 million (+2.4% YoY CC) and guided FY27 revenue growth to 1%–4% CC.
HCLTech was positioned as a Leader in Everest Group's Application Transformation Services for AI-enablement PEAK Matrix Assessment 2025.
HCLTech announced a multi-year partnership with the DP World Tour to become its Official Digital Experience and Marketing Partner.
HCLTech expanded its Cornerstone Partnership with MetLife Stadium, the New York Jets and the New York Giants as an Official AI Partner.
On May 14, 2026, HCLTech announced a strategic collaboration with Red Hat to deliver enterprise-grade AI infrastructure solutions.
HCLTech released its Enterprise AI Market Report warning that 43% of enterprise AI initiatives risk failure.
On 21 May 2026, HCLTech announced it was named Citrix GSI of the Year for enterprise digital workspace transformation.
HCLTech expanded its collaboration with Pegasystems to integrate AI Force and Pega Blueprint for enterprise system modernization.
On May 27, 2026, HCLTech launched its Autonomous Finance Platform integrating Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise.
Roshni Nadar Malhotra, as authorized signatory for HCL Technologies Limited’s promoters and promoter group, declared no encumbrance on shares during FY2026.
HCLTech launched an AI Innovation Zone in Santa Clara in collaboration with Google Cloud.
On October 12, 2026, HCL Technologies reported Q2FY27 revenue of $3,724 million and announced an interim dividend of ₹12 per share.
HCLTech launched an AI-powered verification and validation offering for software-defined vehicles powered by NVIDIA's simulation stack.
On October 26, 2026, HCL Technologies announced a partnership with Rapidus Corporation to establish two semiconductor engineering development centers in India.
HCL Technologies completed the acquisition of 100% stake in Croatia's Robotic Process Automation d.o.o. (Robotiq.ai) via its step-down subsidiary on October 26, 2026.
HCLTech launched an AI-powered nano Global Capability Center offering built on AWS, targeting APAC enterprises in its initial rollout.
